thread:
anya: Quick sync: we must lock the fallback prioritization for reserved pools v1. Sales wants clear wording; ops wants simple, auditable behavior. Can we land on a minimal default and per-tenant override?

mike: Suggest v1 only supports three ordered paths in-region: 1) tenant prewarm (paid), 2) regional shared reserve (soft caps), 3) compatible downscale/quant variant. No cross-region or instance-type shifts yet.

sunil: Ops: agree but require per-tenant soft cap on shared reserve and an emergency toggle. Also require telemetry and alerting before canary.

greta: Product: default must honor prewarm. Expose ordering editor in Console and a "disable fallbacks (latency guarantee)" toggle for tenants.

tom: For billing we need per-request labels: `fallback=true|false`, `path=prewarm|reserve|downscale`, `tenant_id`. Also hourly aggregates for preview.

mike: Runtime work: mapping table (model -> quant variants) + admission control for shared reserve. We need a canary flag to opt a tenant into v1.

ops-bot: DEPLOY NOTE: created flag feature.dedicated.reserve_fallback_v1 for canary gating.

anya: Telemetry must include fallback_event with tenant_id, request_id, original_model, path, added_latency_ms, tokens. Alerts: SLA tenants alert if fallback_rate > 0.3% over 5m or avg_added_latency > 80ms.

sunil: Add an ops dashboard: top tenants by fallback_rate, fallback_path distribution, and median latency delta. Runbook: steps to disable fallback per tenant and to pause the feature globally.

greta: Acceptance criteria (product): Console ordering editor + audit trail, default ordering applied for v1, dashboard tiles for fallback count/% and avg latency penalty, per-tenant disable control, and FAQ copy for customers.

tom: Billing acceptance: hourly ledger `reserve_fallback_ledger:{tenant}:{hour}` with counts and projected token charges. Dry-run CSV export required for pilots.

mike: Config snippet (WIP): `{\"model\":\"redwood-1\",\"fallbacks\":[\"redwood-1-int8\",\"redwood-1-small\"],\"per_tenant_override\":true}` Add unit + integration tests.

anya: Launch gates: spec + UX signoff; mapping table + tests; shared reserve admission + soft caps; telemetry + dashboard; billing ledger + dry-run export; canary to 3 pilot tenants for 72h; rollback toggle in Console and admin API.

sunil: Ops block: alerts and runbook must be in place before canary.

greta: Risk register: quality regressions with quant -> mitigation: model-owner opt-in for GA, validation evals in pilot. Customer confusion -> explanatory response header `x-redwood-fallback` and audit entries. Billing disputes -> dry-run preview + audit logs.

anya: Action items: mike -> runtime spec + mapping example (due Fri); sunil -> alert defs + runbook + dashboard mock (due Tue); greta -> Console UX + copy (due Tue); tom -> billing schema + dry-run plan (due Wed); anya -> recruit 3 pilot tenants and prepare consent (due Mon).

mike: LGTM from eng.

sunil: Ops OK, will block canary until alerts are wired.

greta: Product OK.

tom: Billing OK with dry-run required.

anya: Locking v1 scope. I'll file tickets and follow up in #eng-runtime and #console. Thanks everyone.
